verdict.rationale: Retell provides an official CLI for managing agents/phone numbers/knowledge bases from the terminal, plus typed Node.js/Python SDKs with API key auth and webhooks for event-driven automation — all of which support headless, scriptable use outside the dashboard. However, there is no explicit CI/CD example, pipeline template, or automated-testing-in-CI documentation, and testing features (e.g., Conductor simulations) are presented as dashboard-driven rather than CI-native. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, headless test automation docs, and independent confirmation of CLI/SDK working in automated pipelines.
